name: Kumkum Beauty
market: India, metros and tier-1, e-commerce first, then modern trade and beauty specialty
positioning: Efficacy without irritation, for Indian skin and Indian weather
tone: Precise and unhyped. Explain the science, never oversell it
notes: Regulated by the Drugs & Cosmetics Act and CDSCO, not FSSAI — cosmetic claims only, and claim substantiation is the whole competitive game. Replenishment cycle of roughly three to four months, but the category is trial-driven, so first purchase is the hard part.
avoid: never make a drug or treatment claim
never use before/after imagery that implies a medical outcome
never imply fairness or skin lightening
